shorts.title: GTA 6: Why Online Safe Codes Don't Work
shorts.description:
Store safe codes in GTA 6 are random. Threaten an employee or search the store for the code on a note, a screen or a guard.
Did a code ever work for you? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6: The Save Trap That Costs You Hours
shorts.description:
GTA 6 has 15 manual saves and one autosave. Loading an older save can overwrite your autosave, and you can't save mid-mission.
Ever lost progress? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts
